WORD OF KINDNESS: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 1100 Metres was steadied to avoid CAN’T GO WONG.  WORD OF KINDNESS continued to race keenly in the middle stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
EXCELLENT BOY: Shifted in at the start and made contact with ONLY U.  Crowded near the 1400 Metres.
WHOWROTETHATSONG: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 1500 Metres was steadied when crowded by GRAND TURBO which was taken in by CAN’T GO WONG (M F Poon) which shifted in shortly after being checked.  M F Poon was advised to exercise more care.  Lay in in the Home Straight.
CAN'T GO WONG: Near the 1500 Metres was steadied when crowded by SUPER SICARIO (D B McMonagle) which shifted in whilst being ridden forward and racing to the inside of INCANTO STAR.  D B McMonagle was severely reprimanded and advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to make an effort to straighten his mounts.
GRAND TURBO: Near the 1500 Metres was eased when momentarily crowded by CAN’T GO WONG.
SUPER SICARIO: Near the 600 Metres shifted in and made contact with the running rail.
DRACO: Prior to the running of the event Trainer W K Mo stated that the intention was to hold a handy position preferably with cover.  Following the race he said when caught wide in the early stages DRACO settled in a more forward position than anticipated to avoid covering additional ground.
WINNING DIAMOND: R Kingscote stated that after obtaining a forward position his mount was disappointing in its failure to respond to his riding in the Home Straight.  Trainer D Eustace stated that the horse was disadvantaged by having to be made use of in the early stages to go forward from its wide barrier and this was the reason why it did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ONLY U: Bumped at the start.  Near the 1400 Metres INCANTO STAR (B Avdulla) shifted in, resulting in SUPER SICARIO, EXCELLENT BOY and ONLY U racing in restricted room to the inside of INCANTO STAR.  A short distance later INCANTO STAR was unable to relieve the tightening to its inside when WINNING DIAMOND (R Kingscote) shifted in, resulting in INCANTO STAR being taken in and SUPER SICARIO then shifting in and away from INCANTO STAR before being corrected by its rider which further resulted in EXCELLENT BOY crowding the running of ONLY U which was checked.  R Kingscote was reprimanded.  B Avdulla was advised in similar circumstances to exercise more care.  Sent for sampling post-race.
TO INFINITY: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was bumped by WORD OF KINDNESS.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PRINCE ALEX: S Osborne stated that from a wide barrier she was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages and to make a run to the inside of runners.  Trainer D J Whyte confirmed the instructions issued.
FORZA LEADER: Z Purton was found guilty of a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 1000 Metres (see AUTUMN VIBES).  Sent for sampling post-race.
LOVING VIBES: Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by HEROIC VANGUARD.
CASA PRIMO: Shortly after the start was bumped by LOVING VIBES.  Near the 900 Metres, when racing keenly, improved to the outside of RISING ELITE, resulting in CASA PRIMO shifting out and making contact with ICONICAL.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HEROIC VANGUARD: On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by LAKESHORE HERO.  As a result HEROIC VANGUARD shifted in and made contact with LOVING VIBES.
LAKESHORE HERO: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied when crowded between ICONICAL which shifted in slightly and HEROIC VANGUARD which shifted out making the turn.  Near the 300 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with JOLLY COMPANION.  Near the 150 Metres LAKESHORE HERO again made contact with JOLLY COMPANION and then shifted out when being corrected by C L Chau.   Near the 100 Metres was hampered when taken wider by MAJESTIC DELIGHT (A Atzeni) which shifted out.  As a result LAKESHORE HERO was taken out across JOLLY COMPANION which was steadied.  A Atzeni was severely reprimanded and advised he must stop riding and straighten his mounts when they shift ground whilst not clear.
SMILING CHAMPION: Near the 150 Metres was checked when crowded between JOLLY COMPANION and ICONICAL.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
MAJESTIC DELIGHT: Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded by JOLLY COMPANION which shifted in after being bumped.
AUTUMN VIBES: Shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with ICONICAL.  Z Purton (FORZA LEADER) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 1000 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of AUTUMN VIBES, resulting in AUTUMN VIBES having to be checked to avoid FORZA LEADER.  Z Purton was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 23 December 2026 and to expire on Sunday, 27 December 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.
ICONICAL: After travelling a short distance was crowded between AUTUMN VIBES which shifted out and SMILING CHAMPION which shifted in and away from FORZA LEADER.  Near the 1000 Metres was steadied when crowded by AUTUMN VIBES which shifted out after being checked.  Leaving the 900 Metres was steadied when crowded between SMILING CHAMPION and CASA PRIMO which shifted out when racing keenly.  Near the 150 Metres made contact with SMILING CHAMPION before being corrected by its rider.  J Orman stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but after being crowded after travelling a short distance his mount settled further back in the field than what had been intended.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JOLLY COMPANION: Shortly after the start was bumped by SOLAR RIVER which shifted in slightly.  Making the Home Turn JOLLY COMPANION commenced to improve into a narrow run between SMILING CHAMPION and LAKESHORE HERO.  When LAKESHORE HERO shifted out slightly JOLLY COMPANION and LAKESHORE HERO then made contact for some distance near the 300 Metres.  Near the 150 Metres JOLLY COMPANION, which had continued to make contact with LAKESHORE HERO, was then crowded when LAKESHORE HERO shifted out due to the contact on its hindquarters.  As a result JOLLY COMPANION was crowded and taken across the running of SMILING CHAMPION  which was checked when crowded between JOLLY COMPANION and ICONICAL (J Orman) which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  J Orman was advised in similar circumstances to exercise more care.  D B McMonagle was also advised in similar circumstances he should ensure there is sufficient racing room to improve into, however, the Stewards accepted that LAKESHORE HERO had shifted out, contributing to the run becoming tight.  When giving ground near the 100 Metres was steadied to avoid LAKESHORE HERO which was taken out.  D B McMonagle stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position.  He said after being contacted shortly after the start his mount failed to show sufficient pace to go forward and as a result he was obliged to settle further back in the field to avoid covering additional ground.
SOLAR RIVER: Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUGAR GOODSON: Approaching the 1500 Metres, when racing keenly, got its head up when being steadied to avoid AUTOMATED which shifted in and away from KINGLY DEMEANOR despite the efforts of its rider.  Z Purton stated that near the 1000 Metres he looked down to ensure the bit was properly positioned in the horse’s mouth.
CASA ROCHESTER: L Ferraris stated that his mount travelled only fairly during the event and he was obliged to make use of the horse to hold his position.  He said although his mount experienced difficulty obtaining clear running over the concluding stages, in his opinion, the horse would be better suited when ridden in a more conservative manner in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JUMBO STEPS: C Y Ho reported that from barrier 1 he was instructed to hold an on-pace position to take advantage of the good barrier.
TAKE ACTION: Close to the finish line A Atzeni was obliged to stop riding and straighten his mount when it shifted in towards BEST WORLD.
BEST WORLD: Over the concluding stages B Avdulla was obliged to stop riding and straighten his mount when racing tight to the outside of FAMILY FORTUNE.
KING OF SELECTION: M F Poon reported that he was obliged to settle further back in the field when caught wide in the early stages.  He added that after settling back in the field he was then satisfied with his mount’s finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, KING OF SELECTION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SUPERB KID: Jumped only fairly.  Passing the 50 Metres was shifted to the outside of KYRUS TREASURE to continue into clear running.
AUTOMATED: Lay out over the final 100 Metres.
FAMILY FORTUNE: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Passing the 1500 Metres was steadied to avoid TAKE ACTION. Over the concluding stages raced in restricted room between BEST WORLD and AUTOMATED which lay out and as a result could not be ridden out to the finish of the race.
THUNDER ACTION: Shortly after the start was crowded by DRAGON FOUR SEAS which shifted in.  Near the 250 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between DRAGON FOUR SEAS and SOMELOVEFROMABOVE which was giving ground.  THUNDER ACTION was then shifted to the outside of DRAGON FOUR SEAS near the 200 Metres to obtain clear running.
WORLD HERO: Near the 150 Metres was eased when tightened between VIGOR HAPPINESS and COPARTNER FLEET which shifted in slightly. H Bentley advised that the intention was to hold a more forward position.  He said when caught wide in the early stages and as his mount did not show sufficient pace to go forward he elected to take a trailing position to attempt to obtain cover.  He said when unable to obtain cover his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
CROSSBORDERDUDE: Prior to the running of the event Trainer J Size advised that the horse would be ridden in a more conservative manner in the early stages from its wide barrier as CROSSBORDERDUDE had been finishing its races off only fairly when ridden in a forward position.  After travelling a short distance raced in restricted room between VIGOR HAPPINESS and LIGHTNESS OF BEING which shifted in slightly.
DRAGON FOUR SEAS: Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SOMELOVEFROMABOVE: When giving ground near the 150 Metres shifted out under pressure and as a result made contact with THE PERFECT MATCH.  E C W Wong stated that the intention was to lead the event.  He said after crossing to the front near the 900 Metres SOMELOVEFROMABOVE was disappointing in its finishing effort in the Home Straight but he could offer no explanation for the horse’s performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
THE PERFECT MATCH: Near the 150 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by SOMELOVEFROMABOVE which shifted out when weakening.
FLASH CURRENT: Near the 600 Metres bumped the running rail.  D B McMonagle stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but after jumping only fairly, his mount settled back in the field and he was satisfied with the horse’s finishing effort in the Home Straight.  He added, in his opinion, FLASH CURRENT would benefit from being stepped up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
VIGOR HAPPINESS: Had its right hind plate refitted at the holding stables, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Near the 150 Metres was steadied when crowded between WORLD HERO which was taken in slightly by COPARTNER FLEET (C Y Ho) which shifted in and LIGHTNESS OF BEING which was taken out by THUNDER ACTION (M L Yeung) when THUNDER ACTION lay out.  Both C Y Ho and M L Yeung were advised to exercise more care and to make a greater effort to straighten their mounts when they shift ground whilst not clear.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ULTRA BOLT: Jumped only fairly.  After travelling a short distance was steadied when crowded between THUNDER ACTION and SOMELOVEFROMABOVE which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.
LIGHTNESS OF BEING: Shifted in slightly after travelling a short distance and made contact with CROSSBORDERDUDE.
RUBY THRIVE: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  In the Home Straight hung out under pressure and proved difficult to ride out.
BEAUTY THUNDER: On jumping was crowded between NOBLE FANS and RUBY THRIVE, both of which shifted ground.
HEALTHY HEALTHY: After travelling a short distance was hampered when crowded between CYCLOTRON and NOBLE FANS.  J Orman stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position but after being crowded after travelling a short distance his mount settled further back than intended.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CYCLOTRON: On jumping shifted in and made contact with CAVAMAZING.  After travelling a short distance shifted out slightly and made contact with HEALTHY HEALTHY.
STARRY SHOW: Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, STARRY SHOW will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
TOURBILLON GOLFER: Approaching the finish TOURBILLON GOLFER was steadied to avoid RUBY THRIVE (C Y Ho) which shifted out.  Whilst the Stewards accepted that RUBY THRIVE had shifted reasonably quickly in the incident, Jockey Ho was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
SAME TO YOU: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
JOKER ORBIT: Bumped near the 250 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CHEVAL VICTORIOUS: Jumped awkwardly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
QUICK CONTRIBUTION: Near the 250 Metres was shifted to the inside of BEAUTY THUNDER to obtain clear running and made slight contact with JOKER ORBIT.  Sent for sampling post-race.
NOBLE FANS: Shifted out on jumping and made contact with BEAUTY THUNDER.  Near the 100 Metres was steadied to avoid CYCLOTRON (K C Leung) which shifted out and away from CAVAMAZING.  K C Leung was advised to exercise more care.  A Atzeni stated that after settling back in the field his mount was obliged to make a wide run in the Home Straight.  He said after being steadied near the 100 Metres NOBLE FANS was unable to finish the race off thereafter.
ACE: Jumped only fairly.  Shifted in near the 1600 Metres and was bumped.  Making the Home Turn was steadied and shifted to the inside of AMAZING AWARD to continue into clear running.  ACE then raced tight to the inside of AMAZING AWARD for a short distance thereafter.
EXCEED THE LIMIT: Jumped only fairly.  Z Purton was found guilty of a careless riding charge for causing interference passing the 200 Metres (see ENTHRALLED).  Sent for sampling post-race.
STORMI: Leaving the 200 Metres was checked when crowded between ENTHRALLED which was taken out by EXCEED THE LIMIT and VERMILION TEMPEST (A Badel) which shifted in.  A Badel was reprimanded.
URANUS STAR: Near the 100 Metres was eased when taken out by AMAZING AWARD which was shifted to the outside of LUCK IS BACK to continue into clear running.  C Y Ho reported that from a wide barrier he was required to make too much use of the horse to take up a position closer to the rail and as a result his mount was unable to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NIGHT PUROSANGUE: Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.
ENTHRALLED: Shortly after the start was bumped by NIGHT PUROSANGUE which shifted out.  Z Purton (EXCEED THE LIMIT) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 200 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out when insufficiently clear of ENTHRALLED, resulting in ENTHRALLED losing its rightful running and having to be checked.  Z Purton was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 16 December 2026 at Happy Valley.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 1 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ENTHRALLED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CALIFORNIA MOXIE: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
STURDY RUBY: Despite being ridden along in the early stages failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.  Near the 1600 Metres made contact with ACE which shifted in .
LUCK IS BACK: Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
VERMILION TEMPEST: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
PRESTIGE EMPEROR: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AMAZING AWARD: Held up for clear running making the Home Turn.  Near the 100 Metres was shifted to the outside of LUCK IS BACK to continue into clear running and made contact with URANUS STAR.
CHARMING BABE: Shortly after the start made contact with FLYING TING LOK due to both runners shifting ground.  In the Home Straight lay in under pressure.  For some distance near the 200 Metres was reluctant to shift to the outside of INCREDIBLE MOMENT.
FRIENDS OF SHAJING: Knuckled on jumping.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied to avoid FLYING TING LOK.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ISLAND BUDDY: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  L Ferraris stated that his mount travelled only fairly during the event and when he was concerned there was something amiss in the Home Straight he eased it down.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WITHOUT RHYME: Shifted out at the start and made contact with ORIGIN OF FORM.
FLYING TING LOK: Shortly after the start made contact with CHARMING BABE due to both runners shifting ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, FLYING TING LOK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HERO MASTERMIND: Prior to the running of the event Trainer M Newnham advised that he had instructed L Hewitson to take up a forward position to take advantage of its inside barrier draw.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ORIGIN OF FORM: Jumped only fairly and then was hampered by WITHOUT RHYME which shifted out.  Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, ORIGIN OF FORM will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CALL ME SUCCESS: After weighing out and whilst the horse was in the Parade Ring, S Osborne became ill and was stood down by the Club’s Chief Medical Officer.  As such permission was given for H Bentley to be substituted as the rider of CALL ME SUCCESS.  Jumped awkwardly.  Near the 600 Metres was inconvenienced when momentarily crowded by CHARMING BABE which lay in.
FLYING WROTE: Near the 1500 Metres was eased to avoid HAPPY BOSS (L Ferraris) when that runner shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  L Ferraris was advised to exercise more care.
THE BOOM BOX: Shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with PASS LINE. C Y Ho stated that his mount was disadvantaged by having to make a wide run on the Home Turn and finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CORLEONE: On jumping was bumped by PRECISION TIME which shifted in.  D B McMonagle stated that the instructions were to settle in a midfield position, similar to its most recent start on 4 November 2026.
MAKE YOU SMILE: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HAPPY BOSS: Bumped on jumping.  Sent for sampling post-race.
EMBRACES: Jumped awkwardly.  C L Chau stated that, in his opinion, his mount may have been disadvantaged by racing towards the inside but finished the race off in a one-paced manner in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SMART OINK: Jumped only fairly and then was steadied to avoid FLYING WROTE which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PRECISION TIME: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.
WIN METHOD: Shifted out at the start and made contact with HAPPY BOSS.  From a wide barrier was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SUNDAY'S SERENADE: Withdrawn on 24.11.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (irregular heart rhythm) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter PRECISION TIME.  Before being allowed to race again, SUNDAY’S SERENADE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BRAVE STAR: Shifted out at the start and made contact with ACE CHAMPION.  Approaching the 300 Metres was disappointed for clear running to the outside of QUANTUM CLOUD which shifted out.  As a result BRAVE STAR was shifted to the inside to continue into clear running.
ACE CHAMPION: Bumped on jumping.  C Y Ho could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer P C Ng stated that, in his opinion, the horse may not have been suited by carrying 134 lbs during the race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have blood in the mouth.
CALIFORNIA BLITZ: Bumped on the hindquarters shortly after the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SKY CAP: Raced keenly in the middle stages.
DHURANDHAR: Near the 1000 Metres was eased when momentarily crowded by QUANTUM CLOUD.
FOUR STARS ALIGN: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC: When questioned regarding his riding in the early stages and if there was an opportunity to cross to lead on the rail, E C W Wong stated that his instructions were to go forward and lead if possible but not to make too much use of the horse to do so.  He said those instructions were issued on the basis that LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC has previously been declared a bleeder and the horse was also stepping up from the 1000 Metres to the 1200 Metres tonight.  He said after entering the Back Straight when CALIFORNIA BLITZ was positioned to his inside he contemplated making more use of his mount to cross CALIFORNIA BLITZ but when the horse did not show sufficient pace to do so and he was mindful of his instructions, he elected to remain racing one-off where LIGHTNESS OF MUSIC was travelling comfortably.  The Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Wong were reasonable in the circumstances.
LA FORZA: Near the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid DHURANDHAR.
QUANTUM CLOUD: Approaching the 1000 Metres improved to the inside of FLASHING FIGHTER.  A short distance later was steadied when momentarily crowded by FLASHING FIGHTER (Apprentice H Y Yuen) which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  Apprentice Yuen was advised to exercise more care.  Passing the 350 Metres shifted out to improve and made contact with FLASHING FIGHTER.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, QUANTUM CLOUD will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
YOUNG ARROW: Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with CALIFORNIA BLITZ.  Held up for clear running between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres.
TOGETHER WE VALUE: Over the final 100 Metres raced tight to the inside of CALIFORNIA BLITZ which shifted in under pressure.
